manifest.title: PTS Discord Bot
manifest.author: BrutalBirdie
manifest.tagline: Discord bot with a web UI to schedule voice and message tasks

set-discord-token.message: Set DISCORD_TOKEN in /app/data/env.sh and switch on the Server Members intent of the bot in the Discord Developer Portal. Restart the app after editing env.sh.

set-admins.message: Set admins: add Cloudron usernames to BOT_ADMINS or Cloudron groups to BOT_ADMIN_GROUP in /app/data/env.sh.

manifest.description:
## About

A Discord bot with a web UI to control it. Sign in with your Cloudron account.

* Tasks on a schedule (daily, weekly, once or cron, in any timezone) or started by hand
* Task steps: join a voice channel or the channel a member is in, play a sound, send a message, send a direct message, wait, leave
* Saved messages with text, up to 10 embeds, images and files, with a preview of how Discord shows them
* Media library for sounds, images, videos and files. Sounds can be played in a voice channel right away
* Servers and channels the bot is in, with the permissions it is missing
* Run history per task. Tasks pause themselves on errors retrying cannot fix, and failures can be posted to a channel
* Admins change settings and see an audit log of all changes
manifest.changelog:
* Web UI with Cloudron login, n8n is no longer needed
* Tasks on a schedule or started by hand: join voice, play sounds, send messages and direct messages, wait, leave
* Saved messages with embeds and files, media library, run history and audit log
* Sound files from /app/data/sounds move into the media library
* The HTTP API (POST /play) is removed
manifest.postInstallMessage:
The bot needs a Discord bot token before it connects.

1. Create an application in the [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications). Under **Bot**, click **Reset Token** and copy the token. On the same page, switch on **Server Members Intent**.
2. Set `DISCORD_TOKEN` in `/app/data/env.sh`. Add your Cloudron username to `BOT_ADMINS` there, or a group to `BOT_ADMIN_GROUP`. Restart the app.
3. Open the app, go to **Servers** and add the bot to your Discord server with the invite link.
4. Upload sounds under **Media** and create a task under **Tasks**.

manifest.description:
## About

A Discord bot with a web UI to control it. Sign in with your Cloudron account.

* Tasks on a schedule (daily, weekly, once or cron, in any timezone), on Discord events (voice joins and leaves, new members, keywords in messages) or started by hand
* Task steps: join a voice channel or the channel a member is in, play a sound or a random one with a tag, send a message, send a direct message, wait, leave
* Slash commands in Discord: /play, /task, /stop and /leave
* Saved messages with text, up to 10 embeds, images and files, with a preview of how Discord shows them
* Media library for sounds, images, videos and files, uploaded or added from a link, with tags. Sounds can be played in a voice channel right away
* Servers and channels the bot is in, with the permissions it is missing
* Run history per task. Tasks pause themselves on errors retrying cannot fix, and failures can be posted to a channel
* Admins change settings and see an audit log of all changes
manifest.changelog:
* Tasks can start on Discord events: a member joins or leaves a voice channel, a new member joins, a message contains a keyword
* Event tasks can be limited to specific members
* Steps can use the member who started the run: join their voice channel, send them a direct message, {member} in texts
* Slash commands /play, /task, /stop and /leave
* Tags for sounds, Play steps and /play can pick a random sound with a tag
* Add media from a link
* Join button for voice channels on the server page
* Runs missed while the app was down show up as skipped in the run history
manifest.postInstallMessage:
The bot needs a Discord bot token before it connects.

1. Create an application in the [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications). Under **Bot**, click **Reset Token** and copy the token. On the same page, switch on **Server Members Intent**, and **Message Content Intent** if tasks should react to keywords in messages.
2. Set `DISCORD_TOKEN` in `/app/data/env.sh`. Add your Cloudron username to `BOT_ADMINS` there, or a group to `BOT_ADMIN_GROUP`. Restart the app.
3. Open the app, go to **Servers** and add the bot to your Discord server with the invite link.
4. Upload sounds under **Media** and create a task under **Tasks**.

manifest.description:
## About

A Discord bot with a web UI to control it. Sign in with your Cloudron account.

* Tasks on a schedule (daily, weekly, once or cron, in any timezone), on Discord events (voice joins and leaves, new members, keywords in messages) or started by hand
* Task steps: join a voice channel or the channel a member is in, play a sound or a random one with a tag, send a message, send a direct message, wait, leave
* Slash commands in Discord: /play, /task, /stop and /leave
* Saved messages with text, up to 10 embeds, images and files, with a preview of how Discord shows them
* Media library for sounds, images, videos and files, uploaded one by one or as a zip, or added from a link, with tags. Sounds can be played in a voice channel right away
* Servers and channels the bot is in, with the permissions it is missing
* Run history per task. Tasks pause themselves on errors retrying cannot fix, and failures can be posted to a channel
* Admins change settings and see an audit log of all changes
manifest.changelog:
* Every page sits in the Control Room: server rail, channel list and members, no top navigation; on phones the servers and channels open from the side
* Home shows the overview with the tasks that need attention, and the Trash; Tasks, Messages and Media open per server, its own items first
* Settings open full window from the user panel, with the Admin pages for admins; server settings open from the server name
* One Edit sheet for every media file, with server group, and for sounds the waveform, emoji or image and own volume
* The media page filters by several tags with their icons, uploads with one button or a drop anywhere on the page
* Images are picked from thumbnails, message button emoji with the emoji picker
* Quick and direct messages have the mention picker and the Discord preview
* Control Room: the server like in Discord, with channels, who is in voice, members by role with status and activity, right-click menus, and task controls
* Soundboard with favorites, emoji or image per sound, preview, per-user play volume and an Upload new tile; a new sound cuts short the one before
* Edit sound: display name, tags, own volume and the part to play, cut on a waveform
* The soundboard lists the tags with an icon each; picking tags shows only the sounds with all of them, the counts follow, uploads there get the tags
* Media files can have a display name
* Media upload is one button or a drop, with progress; a .zip is unpacked into the library
* After an upload: add tags to all its files at once, then review them one by one; a single file opens its Edit sheet
* Tags can be added to the selected files of the media list
* Play steps in the task editor can upload sounds and add them to the step
* Discord login for server members, access approved by an admin per server
* Media and messages are open to every user, with optional server groups
* Saved messages can have buttons that start a task or open a link
* Message previews render Discord markdown with a formatting help, and show the bot's avatar
* Event tasks can leave members out, and warn when several tasks start on the same event
* Play steps can play several sounds in order or one at random, wait steps wait for voice conditions
* A step that changes the bot's nickname and avatar in a server
* Deleted tasks, messages and media go to a Trash first
* Steps can be moved by drag and drop, lists have search and pages
* Stop button for running runs, skipped playback shows in the run history
* Servers in each user's own order, missing bot permissions are shown
* The web app no longer reloads: links and forms show the next page in place, pages update live, searches, filters and pages of lists work in place; notices can be dismissed
* Tag picker with suggestions for media tags
* Playback stops in an empty channel, on a stall and at a run time limit
* Needs the Presence intent for online status in the Control Room (optional)
manifest.postInstallMessage:

1. Create an application in the [Discord Developer Portal](https://discord.com/developers/applications). Under **Bot**, click **Reset Token** and copy the token. On the same page, switch on **Server Members Intent**, **Presence Intent** for who is online in the Control Room, and **Message Content Intent** if tasks should react to keywords in messages.
2. Set `DISCORD_TOKEN` in `/app/data/env.sh`. Add your Cloudron username to `BOT_ADMINS` there, or a group to `BOT_ADMIN_GROUP`. Restart the app.
3. Open the app, go to **Servers** and add the bot to your Discord server with the invite link.
4. Upload sounds under **Media** and create a task under **Tasks**.
